THE TWO LOOSE FINDINGS WERE ACTIONED, not left in a report. MPI-509 was created for the real defect - a remote install that reports success having installed nothing when _filterDepsForEngine empties the request - and it is linked on MPI-450 as explicitly NOT gating 1.4 (pre-existing, no user path reaches it). The other finding was a fact rather than a defect, so it went to docs/download-manager.md section 'The HF path stages OFF the volume and moves the file across on completion' instead of a card: an in-flight HF install shows 49,664 bytes on the volume with 1.27GB fetched and jumps to the full 26.37GB on completion.
pending: ITEM 1 - MPI-483 IS NOW ONE REQUEST, NOT A POD SESSION. Start a large aria2 (R2/models.cubric.studio) install on a Pod and call GET /remote/pod/ls while it runs. Read `accounting.phantomBytes`: a large positive value means sparse .part files are on the volume, the bug is real and the 0.2.44 fix removes it; a value near zero means the filesystem allocated the whole declared length up front and THIS CARD'S PREMISE DOES NOT HOLD. Do not re-run the app-side /remote/pod/disk experiment - it cannot answer the question and this session proved that twice.

ITEM 2 - MPI-481's live leg still owed, and the naive repro does NOT work. The corpse will not stay dead: the download keeps running for seconds after delete-active returns {deleted:true}, so a 2.15GB dep finished at 99.96% and a 14.31GB one killed at 29% was at 59% minutes later. Use a SLOW huggingface-hosted dep so the kill lands comfortably mid-file (481 only needs the app's in-flight cache stale, NOT a partial on the volume), or STOP the Pod instead of deleting it - that is the same-id/empty-_installs case the fix's own notes name. Then press Install again and grep app.log for `stale in-flight record for <depId> - the wrapper has no such install; reinstalling`.

ITEM 3 - FIVE PIECES OF NEW UNTESTED CONTENT, announced by Fabio 2026-08-09 21:35Z and written into MPI-450's Gate B: PID becomes FOUR plugins (sibling cards MPI-506/507), SeedVR2 arrives as THREE more, MiniMax H3 gained a new LoRA and a new video-preview decoder, the LTX workflows gained a Tiny VAE decoder, and Krea 2 NSFW goes to HuggingFace which restores its fallback route. All five need a smoke pass. Fabio said he has an agent on the decoder work - do not duplicate it.

ITEM 4 - RE-SMOKE MiniMax H3, STILL LAST. Unchanged instruction, and now MORE true: the H3 graphs moved again this session (MPI-508 is live in `doing` for the lightx2v turbo LoRA at 6 steps). dev_configs/smoke-evidence.json's two H3 rows describe a superseded graph and release:check cannot detect it. When the graph freezes: node scripts/smoke-workflows.mjs --models minimax-h3 --keep-volume --volume aghcuvg7nl. cp dev_configs/smoke-run.txt first - ANY invocation truncates it.

ITEM 5 - MPI-249 Linux leg on the REAL 1.4.0 artifact (still blocked until the bump), then /mpi-version-bump -> 1.4.0, fold UNRELEASED.md into RELEASE_NOTES['1.4.0'], release:check, release:approve --yes, CI artifacts, /mpi-release.
ITEM 6 - PUSH IS OWED. Commit 0331200f is local; `git push` was blocked by the Bash classifier. Either the user pushes, or a Bash permission rule is added.

ITEM 7 - MPI-433 stays BLOCKED until its own step 1 passes: confirm CivitAI 573152 is actually public. The card gates on 2026-08-10 and Fabio said this on the 9th, so it is one day early on the face of it; MPI-430 deferred precisely to avoid redistributing a paid-early-access weight. That check needs the VPN (CivitAI region-blocks the UK; agent WebFetch can never reach it). When it lands, UNRELEASED.md:423 'Four files still have a single route' becomes three.

THE POD WRAPPER IS UNREACHABLE FROM THE SHELL. curl to https://<podId>-8889.proxy.runpod.net returns exit code 000 even with the right CUBRIC_TOKEN (readable at GET /runpod/pods/<id> -> env.CUBRIC_TOKEN); the app reaches it fine from its server process. Every wrapper endpoint needs an app route in front of it.
ROUTES DO NOT HOT-RELOAD. GET /remote/pod/ls exists on disk but the app that has been running since 18:41 does NOT serve it - it needs an app restart before the MPI-483 check can run.
H3 TESTS STAY LAST. The graph is still moving - MPI-508 is live in `doing` for the turbo LoRA swap.
NEVER delete or shrink volume aghcuvg7nl (cubric-smoke, 450GB, EU-RO-1). Always --keep-volume.
POST /runpod/pods IS createPod, NOT a list route. GET /runpod/pods/<id> -> 404 is how you prove a Pod is gone.
A Pod delete does NOT stop the download promptly - it keeps running for seconds after {deleted:true}. Any experiment that depends on interrupting a fast R2 download will fail.
THE TREE IS SHARED with two live sibling sessions. Commit by explicit pathspec only. NEVER git checkout -- / restore / stash / reset --hard / clean.

BASH: heredocs are hook-blocked, and so is a backslash-newline continuation (backslashes are halved). Write scripts with the Write tool and run them by path. json.load on board.json needs encoding='utf-8'.
